title: Monotonicity of zero-error time
statement: Let $T_1,T_2:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ satisfy $T_1(n)\le T_2(n)$ for every $n$. Then every language decidable in zero-error expected time bounded by $T_1$ is also decidable in zero-error expected time bounded by $T_2$.
hypotheses_covered: $T_1$ and $T_2$ are functions from the natural numbers to the natural numbers
